concepts_note: Concepts are 1 to 3 word phrases from titles and abstracts (a vocabulary chosen from works up to each year), not OpenAlex topic ids. Coverage uses topic ids.

corpus.note: The corpus ends in 2026. Snapshot years after 2026 are absent, not zero: no map, gap or coverage file exists for them.

headline_metrics.verdict: model beats best baseline (current_weight) on average_precision: interval excludes 0

headline_source: held-out backtest (backtest.json); the production forecast has no result

layout.method: truncated SVD of positive-PMI co-occurrence matrix, per year
layout.note: Positions are a 2D projection (truncated SVD of the positive-PMI co-occurrence matrix) of this year's snapshot only, so points can move between years. Distance is not research similarity.

production_forecast.label: Production forecast, not the held-out test. The model frozen for the backtest (fit on origins [2010, 2011, 2012, 2013, 2014], calibrated at [2017]; no test origin used) ranks pairs that have not yet co-occurred 3+ times at the 2026 snapshot, the last year in the corpus. Their outcomes (2027 to 2029) are not observed, so nothing in this file was evaluated. The held-out result is in backtest.json.
